name: Vivica's Heart
source:
With no memories and no sense of self, you are brought to a witch’s house deep in the forest. To regain your life, you must break into the house, complete a task... and survive whatever you may find in there.

[From [url=https://justababy-studio.itch.io/vivicas-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
